summary: Temperature sensor breakout board powered from 3.3 V via a 4-pin header, featuring one digital I2C temperature sensor with required pull-up resistors and supply decoupling.
purpose: Provide a compact breakout for a digital I2C temperature sensor, interfacing to a 3.3 V logic system via a 4-pin header.
constraints: I2C communication via SDA and SCL lines
Requires pull-up resistors for I2C lines
Requires supply decoupling for the sensor

required.detail: I2C pull-up resistors (one for SDA, one for SCL)
Supply decoupling capacitor (for the sensor's VCC pin)
